featurebullets: About this item Compact 0.7 Cu. Ft. Capacity – The 0.7 cu. ft. interior provides efficient cooking in a compact microwave, ideal for kitchens, dorm rooms, offices, and other small spaces Powerful 700-Watt Cooking – Heat and cook a variety of foods with 700 watts of power and 5 selectable power levels for customized cooking performance One-Touch Auto Cook Menus – Eight pre-programmed cooking menus make it easy to prepare popular foods such as popcorn, pizza, beverages, frozen dinners, and more at the touch of a button Auto Defrost & Express Cooking – The auto defrost function automatically calculates the appropriate defrosting time and power level, while express cooking provides quick heating with a single touch Simple Digital Controls – A bright LED display and digital clock provide clear visibility and convenient everyday operation Even Heating Performance – The glass turntable rotates during cooking to help promote even heating and is easy for cleaning Retro Style – The retro-inspired design adds classic character while complementing a variety of kitchen styles › See more product details
